packages.label: שָׁלוֹם וְיוֹסֵף וְקִדּוּשׁ הַשֵּׁם
packages.reason: All nodes in this package share the essential nature of the union of opposites — chasadim (love/drawing-close) and gevurot (discipline/pushing-away) held together as one. Shalom IS the joining of chasadim and gevurot; Yosef IS shalom (he joins his brothers through both rebuke and love); kiddush Hashem IS the embodiment of chasadim+gevurot (first the flame of love, then the steel of self-sacrifice); the second vav IS Yosef (letter-identity); self-sacrifice IS Yosef's archetype; Israel and the first vav are merged here because the text teaches that the first vav (Israel) cannot be pronounced without the second vav (Yosef) — they are inseparable partners, two faces of the same reality. The composite nodes 'hands and feet' and 'chokhmah and speech' are included because they represent the same synthesis: the pairing of the two poles which is the very definition of shalom in this Torah.

merge_notes.merge_reason: The Torah teaches: 'Israel is bechina of vav (the first vav), and vav cannot be pronounced without a second vav, which is bechina of Yosef.' Israel-as-first-vav and Yosef-as-second-vav are two aspects of the same indissoluble reality. They share the same essential nature as the two poles that constitute shalom. Bechina basis: Israel's core identity IS its vav-nature, and the vav-nature IS the peace-union archetype. Merged into Package 1 on bechina (shared nature), not eitza.

These composite nodes articulate the paired structure that IS shalom in this Torah: the two extremities (hands=chokhmah, feet=speech) unified in the person of Yosef. The proof text explicitly states: 'Yosef encompasses hands and feet, which are chokhmah and speech.' The composite node's essential nature is the synthesis of the two poles — which is precisely what shalom/Yosef IS. Merged into Package 1 on bechina (the unity of both poles is what defines this package).

packages.label: חָכְמָה וּמֹחִין וְקֹדֶשׁ
packages.reason: All nodes in this package share the essential nature of the primordial, inward, intellectual dimension of holiness — the 'head' of reality. Chokhmah IS the reishit (first-fruit, beginning); reishit IS kodesh (all beginnings are holy); kodesh IS chokhmah (the verse 'raise your hands in holiness' is interpreted as hands = kodesh = reishit = chokhmah). Mochin (the divine brain/intellect) IS chokhmah — the proof text for 'ido' (his hand) connects: hand → kodesh → reishit → chokhmah/mochah. YHVH IS mochin (as universally known in Kabbalah). The hands (yadim) are bechina of chokhmah. All are expressions of the same primal intelligent force: the upper, inward, masculine dimension of divine wisdom.

merge_notes.merge_reason: The proof text for edge 1742 explicitly traces the chain: 'his hand = mochin, because kodesh = reishit = chokhmah/mochah.' Mochin IS chokhmah (the terms are used interchangeably in the Zoharic tradition that underpins this Torah). YHVH = mochin is stated outright. The essential nature of mochin, chokhmah, kodesh, and ראשית is identical — all are the primordial divine intellectual faculty. Merged on bechina (shared essence), not eitza.

packages.label: דִּבּוּר וּגְבוּרוֹת וִירוּשָׁלַיִם
packages.reason: All nodes in this package share the essential nature of the outward, expressive, lower dimension — the faculty of holy speech and its structural manifestations. Speech IS gevurot (ugevuratcha yedaberu — your strength they will speak); speech IS Yerushalayim (the city of speech/tzedek); tzedek IS speech (tzedek tedaberun); legs/raglayim ARE speech (legs are the lower limbs that carry/express, parallel to speech as the outward expression of inner wisdom); the foot (raglo) IS gevurot (tzedek runs at his foot). All are aspects of the same expressive, outward, structuring force — the domain of the holy word, the mouth, the kingdom that receives and expresses what chokhmah/mochin sends. In this Torah's framework, speech in prayer and Torah study is the holy goal, and gevurot/legs/tzedek are its parallel aspects.
